# Pull Request

## What changed?

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## How was it tested?

- [ ] C++ targets compile
- [ ] CTest passes
- [ ] `cpp-foundation quality --root . --mode fast` passes
- [ ] Release or deployment changes have a rollback note

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials or production data are included
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes are updated when needed
